Definition
[Almost geometrically tame end] \group thurston.ch09.endsSource: thurston:page-0246 For a cusped hyperbolic manifold $N$, an end of $N-P$ is almost geometrically tame if a finite-sheeted cover of it agrees, outside a compact set, with a geometrically tame end.
